# Components Reference

Source: Junaid/templates/components.md (STRONG_HEURISTIC)

## Purpose
Reusable component design and variant structuring.

## Guidelines
1. Design atomic components (Button, Input, Card, Badge) with clear prop interfaces.
2. Avoid unnecessary card wrapping or nested wrappers when direct layout suffices.
3. Use semantic tokens for padding, border radius, and colors within components.
